<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1301_1282023-4" status="reviewed">
<milestone unit="section" n="v. 2"/> 
       <lg><l>gang ma mthong pas srid par 'khyams gyur pa ||</l> <l>bdag la shes bya'i gnas la gnas nyid bzhin ||</l> <l>lta byed tshad ma'i myig gnyis sbyin mdzad pa'i ||</l>
            <l>rgyal mtshungs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma rnams</rs> la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I bow down to the bla mas, who are like Victorious ones,
Who bestowed the two eyes of valid cognition that make one see
The nature of objects of cognition as it is
To me, who was roaming in existence because of not seing.
</note></seg></TEI>
